items.title: Behind the Ticker: How VFLO Beats Growth at Its Own Game
items.summary: Free cash flow funds are having a moment, but many of the traditional FCF strategies miss the bigger picture and greater return potential. Victory Capital’s Mannik Dhillon breaks down how VFLO turned a forward-looking value investing strategy into one of the decade’s biggest ETF launches, all without a single Mag 7 stock, in this episode of Behind the Ticker.

items.title: Moderna (MRNA): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?

items.title: RocketLab Rises on Space Interest; Moderna Moves on Flu Shot | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - RocketLab (RKLB) shares are higher this morning after rising Friday, following earnings from SpaceX last week. - Moderna (MRNA) shares are moving after last week's news that its mRNA flu shot won US approval in an FDA turnaround. - Intel (INTC) shares are moving after the company said it will be offering $15 billion in common stock, taking advantage of renewed interest in its business prospects during the artificial intelligence data center boom.
